correctness.rationale: Two independently written finite exhaustive programs verify that no one of all C(30,5)=142506 five-subsets resolves and that precisely 32460 of all C(30,6)=593775 six-subsets resolve. The first computes 210 explicit same-side pair distinguishability constraints from proved incidence distances and BFS; the second uses BFS and direct distinctness of all 30 distance vectors. Monotonicity proves the six-vertex minimum. S6 edge/factor action, a checked side-switching duality and maximal five-star rigidity prove the complete automorphism group order 1440; enumerated orbits exhaust and partition all 32460 sets, in the declared 34 sizes. Neither a timeout nor an incomplete search is treated as a proof.
